notes: football/soccer is the most useful pair on the page: in American English football is a
different game entirely, and a Colombian learner saying 'football' to an American will be
misunderstood. They stay in one unit.
'swimming' also appears as 'swimming pool' in House and Home. Different areas.

area.name: Sports
area.description: Los deportes de pelota y los demás, y por qué football no quiere decir fútbol.

units.name: Ball sports
units.topic: The sports played with a ball. This is the important one: in American English 'soccer' is the game played with the feet and 'football' is a different sport played with the hands and a pointed ball. A learner who says football to an American means the wrong game

units.name: Other sports
units.topic: The sports played without a ball, in a pool, a ring or on a track
